entries.effect: NO. The 26.2 CoreGraphics headers expose NO trailer accessor - grep for kCGPDFContextTrailer and for Encrypt across CGPDFDictionary.h and CGPDFContext.h returns nothing - and CGPDFDocument offers only -CGPDFDocumentGetInfo, so /Encrypt is unreachable from a CGPDFDocument and the port cannot read the key that would make a document encrypted.
